claude.performance_metric: systems integration completed in 2018; no goodwill impairment (Oct 2020 test); no separate performance line retained
claude.rationale: The slice documents that "we completed systems integration for the Capital Bank transaction in 2018" and that balance-sheet/operating impact was folded smoothly into consolidated results, with no documented product/process incoherence realized over time (p4=0). No process/organization fracture is documented: the former CEO R. Eugene Taylor continued board service and the 2020 segment reorganization is explicitly attributed to First Horizon's broader restructuring "rather than to the Capital Bank Financial transaction specifically" (p5=0). No documented archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility appears; the goodwill test "did not indicate impairment in any of FHN's reporting units," and no adverse integration events are recorded. Absence of documented disruption is coded 0 per convention.
